name: Fairmont Orchid
insider_take: This oceanfront paradise sits on 32 acres of ancient lava rock coastline, where Hawaiian royalty once gathered and green sea turtles still call home.
whats_special: The Fairmont Orchid is built on sacred Hawaiian grounds along the Kohala Coast's "Gold Coast," featuring a unique sandy beach lagoon carved from natural lava rock. The resort houses one of Hawaii's most comprehensive cultural programs and sits adjacent to ancient petroglyphs and fishponds dating back over 700 years.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the Spa Without Walls before 10 AM - you'll have oceanfront cabanas mostly to yourself and often spot Hawaiian green sea turtles basking on the rocks below.
dont_miss: The complimentary guided snorkeling at Pauoa Bay, home to vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish just steps from your room. Also explore the resort's historic walking trail featuring authentic Hawaiian petroglyphs and learn about the area's significance to Polynesian navigation.
pros: Stunning oceanfront setting on the Kohala Coast with direct beach access and pristine snorkeling lagoons
World-class dining options including signature Hawaiian cuisine showcasing locally sourced ingredients
Exceptional Willow Stream Spa offering culturally inspired treatments rooted in Hawaiian healing traditions
Spacious, elegantly appointed rooms and suites with sweeping Pacific Ocean views
Rich array of resort activities including outrigger canoe lessons, cultural programming, and championship golf nearby
cons: Remote Kohala Coast location requires a car or resort shuttle for off-property dining and exploration
Premium luxury resort pricing may not suit all budgets
Popular resort amenities such as pool areas and restaurant reservations can book up quickly during peak seasons
